releaseNotes:
- Right-click an FTP/SFTP folder to manage path mappings (list + add, without replacing existing rows)
- Connection Manager Browse now lists folders for SFTP as well as FTP
- Direct Upload: right-click a file or folder to see size, created, and modified dates
- FTP/SFTP: right-click a file or folder to see size, dates, and folder contents
- FTP/SFTP: change file/folder permissions (chmod) with a reason in the same dialog if the server refuses
